title: Adjust a natural coordinate on a tensor-unit object
statement: Let C,D,E be categories, with D monoidal. Let K:C→E and P:C→D be functors, H:D→E an equivalence, p0:K≅P H a natural isomorphism, U in C, V in D with j:V≅1_D, i:P(U)≅V and u:K(U)≅H(V). There is a natural isomorphism p:K≅P H with p_U followed by H(i)=u. This asserts no new data on tensor products or monoidal structure of p.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite coefficient identification before the system splitting

proof.text: A unit automorphism e induces a natural automorphism of the identity: conjugate tensoring with e by left unitors. Equality of left and right unitors at the unit shows its component there is e. Naturality transports this assertion to any object isomorphic to the unit.

Lift the discrepancy (p0_U H(i)) inverse followed by u through the fully faithful H. Extend it as above, whisker with H and P, and postcompose p0. Naturality at i and cancellation of the discrepancy give the prescribed component.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1); D2 constructs normalized coefficient coordinates and transports adjunctions, allowing the existential inverse-image comparison to be adjusted on the tensor unit

lean.statement:
theorem finiteP1_adjust_coordinate_unit
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (K : C ⥤ E) (P : C ⥤ D) (H : D ⥤ E) [H.IsEquivalence]
    (p0 : K ≅ P ⋙ H) (U : C) (V : D) (j : V ≅ 𝟙_ D)
    (i : P.obj U ≅ V) (u : K.obj U ≅ H.obj V) :
    ∃ p : K ≅ P ⋙ H, p.hom.app U ≫ H.map i.hom = u.hom
